@graph.name: Steven L. Woodfield
@graph.description: Steven was raised in a faithful Christian family with a love of Christmas. As for most, the magic of Christmas wanes as we age. These stories of Santa rekindle the belief in the magic of Christmas.

@graph.name: Superhero Santa: Christ-Centered Christmas Books for Toddlers
@graph.description: A toddler bedtime picture-book series where Santa is the helper and Christmas has a hero. Book One, “Santa, the Reindeer Are Missing!”, is coming soon.

@graph.name: Superhero Santa
@graph.description: Christmas picture books in which Santa is brave, kind and a little bit super, but not the point: every adventure ends where Christmas begins, with a family, a bright star and the birth of Jesus. The series begins with a toddler bedtime reader; a full-edition picture book and a children’s book are to follow, with a novel series for teens in development.

@graph.name: Santa, the Reindeer Are Missing!
@graph.description: Book One of the Superhero Santa series: a toddler bedtime reader for ages 1 to 3. After the presents have been delivered and the New Year has rung in, the nine sleigh Reindeer vanish. Santa, Mrs. Claus and the elves follow a long, snowy trail, and the story ends where Christmas begins: with a family and a bright star witnessing the birth of Jesus. Short lines and big pictures, made to read aloud. Coming in print and ebook in fall 2027.

mainEntity.name: What ages is Santa, the Reindeer Are Missing! for?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ages 1 to 3. Book One is a toddler bedtime reader: short lines, big pictures, about a ten-minute read, made to read aloud.

mainEntity.name: Is Superhero Santa a Christian book series?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Santa is brave, kind and more than a little bit super, but he's the helper, not the point: every Superhero Santa book ends where Christmas begins, with a family, a bright star and the birth of Jesus.

mainEntity.name: Is Santa, the Reindeer Are Missing! in print or ebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both: Book One is coming soon in print and ebook, in fall 2027.

mainEntity.name: Are more Superhero Santa books coming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Superhero Santa is currently a five-book series.
